# Guides at University of Pittsburgh

> LibGuides portal providing research support, course guides, subject resources, and library services across University of Pittsburgh's Pittsburgh, Greensburg, and Bradford campuses.

The University of Pittsburgh Library System uses LibGuides (powered by Springshare) to organize research guides, course materials, and subject-specific resources for students and faculty. The platform includes specialized guides for STEM services, social justice topics, academic writing, and campus-specific resources.

## Key Topics

- University of Pittsburgh Library System
- PittCat (catalog search)
- STEM Library Services
- Course guides
- Research guides
- Subject guides
- Pittsburgh Campus
- Greensburg Campus
- Bradford Campus
- Copyright and intellectual property
- Academic research and writing
- Social justice resources
- LibGuides platform
- Provenance research
- Library services

## Core Library Services & Navigation

- [Home - Guides at University of Pittsburgh](https://pitt.libguides.com): Main homepage for University of Pittsburgh Library guides portal
- [Profiles - Guides at University of Pittsburgh](https://pitt.libguides.com/prf.php): Directory of librarian profiles at University of Pittsburgh
- [STEM Library Services Overview - STEM Library Services @ Pitt](https://pitt.libguides.com/stemservices): Overview of STEM Library Services and research support at Pitt

## Research & Writing Guides

- [Overview - Copyright for Researchers](https://pitt.libguides.com/copyright-research): Guide to copyright issues for researchers and scholarly publishing
- [Getting Started - Research and Writing in Economics](https://pitt.libguides.com/econwriting): Guide to research and writing methods in economics discipline
- [Getting Started - Provenance Research @ Pitt](https://pitt.libguides.com/provenanceresearch): Getting started guide for provenance research at Pitt libraries
- [CSR Book & Article Research - Corporate Social Responsibility Resources](https://pitt.libguides.com/csr): Research guide for Corporate Social Responsibility books and articles

## Course Guides by Subject

- [Home - Spanish Capstone - Greensburg Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/spanishcapstone): Course guide for Spanish Capstone Seminar at Greensburg Campus
- [Find Resources using PittCat - Strategic Management: Capstone - Bradford Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/mgmtbradford): Research guide for Strategic Management Capstone using PittCat resources
- [Searching PittCat - Religion in India - Pittsburgh Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/religionindia): Course guide for Religion in India with PittCat search instructions
- [Home - History of Northern Ireland - Pittsburgh Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/irishhistory): Course guide for History of Northern Ireland research and resources
- [Finding Books - ENGLIT 1910: Feeling Literary - Pittsburgh Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/feelingliterary): Course guide for ENGLIT 1910 with book finding resources
- [Getting Started - History Capstone - Greensburg Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/upghistory): Getting started guide for History Capstone at Greensburg Campus
- [Home - History of the English Language - Greensburg Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/englishlanguage): Course guide for History of English Language at Greensburg Campus

## Social Justice & Special Topics

- [MLK Home - Social Justice Topics @ Pitt: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Resources](https://pitt.libguides.com/socialjustice/mlk): Research guide for Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and civil rights topics
- [Home - Gao Archive 1989 China/Avant-Garde Exhibition: Reflections](https://pitt.libguides.com/Gao_exhibit): Exhibition guide for Gao Archive 1989 China/Avant-Garde art collection

## Campus-Specific Resources

- [Welcome - The Wellness Room Resources - Bradford Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/wellness): Guide to Wellness Room resources for mental health and stress management
- [Welcome - Service-Learning Resources - Bradford Campus](https://pitt.libguides.com/servicelearning): Guide to service-learning resources at Bradford Campus
